notes.title: Our new project "Y'Ryando" will be crowdfunded on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Our new project "Y'Ryando" will be crowdfunded on Kickstarter on January 22, 2024.
This is a text adventure game that enhances the gameplay, and yes, it is essentially about storytelling. The game is expected to be launched in the summer of 2024.
You can search "Y'Ryando" on the crowdfunding platform to learn more about the game. I will update more content about the game on my Bilibili account later.
Search for "IndieCain" on Bilibili, follow me, or just come and play the game!
